# Gamino Real Estate

> Family-owned residential rental company on Milwaukee's south side (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA). Two generations of the Gamino family own and personally maintain six historic apartment buildings. Direct, bilingual service in Spanish and English. No call center, no outside management company. Equal Housing Opportunity.

Website: https://gaminorealestate.com
Founder: Carlos L. Gamino
Languages: Spanish (español) and English

## Buildings (6 buildings, 37 units)

- 3110 W Pierce St, Milwaukee, WI 53215 | Silver City | built 1928 | 14 units | https://gaminorealestate.com/propiedades/pierce-3110.html
- 1750-1752 S Muskego Ave, Milwaukee, WI 53204 | Historic Mitchell Street | built 1912 | 9 units (7 apartments + 2 storefronts) | https://gaminorealestate.com/propiedades/muskego-1750.html
- 1968 S Muskego Ave, Milwaukee, WI 53204 | Mitchell Street | built 1900 | 4 units | https://gaminorealestate.com/propiedades/muskego-1968.html
- 1754-1756 S Muskego Ave, Milwaukee, WI 53204 | Mitchell Street | built 1913 | 4 units | https://gaminorealestate.com/propiedades/muskego-1754.html
- 2176-2178 S 11th St, Milwaukee, WI 53215 | Lincoln Village | built 1900 | 4 units | https://gaminorealestate.com/propiedades/eleventh-2176.html
- 210 E Smith St, Milwaukee, WI 53207 | Bay View | built 1892 | 2-unit duplex | https://gaminorealestate.com/propiedades/smith-210.html

All buildings: https://gaminorealestate.com/propiedades/

## What is available now

- Current openings: https://gaminorealestate.com/#disponibles
- Available today page: https://gaminorealestate.com/disponible-hoy
- Availability changes; call or check the pages above. Rents are quoted directly by the family.

## How to apply

- Apply online at https://gaminorealestate.com/#solicitar
- Applying is free. There is no application fee.
- The Gamino family contacts applicants directly within 1-2 business days, in Spanish or English.
- Book a viewing: https://gaminorealestate.com/agenda

## Current tenants

- Maintenance requests: https://gaminorealestate.com/mantenimiento/
- Emergencies (flooding, fire, gas, no heat): call (414) 850-CASA right away. If you smell gas, leave the building and call 911 and We Energies first.
